pricing_billing_confirmation: Published unit prices only; actual invoice NOT_RUN/unconfirmed. Runtime guard owns enforceable reservations.

retrieval.rewrite_output_policy: standalone retrieval question only; no new factual answer; untrusted history/question remain data

app_deadlines.live_rag_change_reason: B adds bounded rewrite, query embedding, and answer calls (3 x 8s);28s allows bounded local search/validation overhead. Local15sunchanged. No paid timeout tests.

experiment.paired_order: R01:A,R01:B,R02:B,R02:A alternating per case; preserve each fixed history independently, never use prior generated output as history
experiment.adoption: No adoption decision until complete paired observations and separate semantic review; no forced adoption of B.

cache_policy.provider_prompt_cache: not controllable; record cached_input_tokens, never assume zero or savings in reservation
cache_policy.cold_warm: record first request after provider-process startup as cold; remaining requests warm; preserve startup run ID; one pass no paid warmup; no cold/warm equality claim

metric_definitions.hit_at_3: per variant: successful answerable cases whose first 3 retrieved stable source IDs intersect evaluator evidence / all executed answerable cases (errors/timeouts count as misses). Planned16 pervariant; NOT_RUN omitted from executed denominator and completeness reported. No score without observed cases.
metric_definitions.source_ids: cited subset of actual context subset of retrieved top3, with same material/version; automatic structural check, not semantic grounding
metric_definitions.answer_grounding: human review per answer and exact provided references; defaults NOT_RUN. Developer judgments must be labeled automatic_preliminary, never human PASS.
metric_definitions.absence_abstention: self-reported abstained on successful absent cases / executed absent cases, errors/timeouts failures; claim is behavior only until semantic review
metric_definitions.grading_agreement: boolean is_correct equal fixed expected value / all executed grading cases, errors/timeouts failures; planned16; no claim of expert validity
metric_definitions.latency: Record rewrite/query_embedding/vector_search/retrieval_including_query_embedding/answer/grading/total exactly as app stages. Retrieval inclusive is diagnostic, not additive with query_embedding/vector_search. Medians and n, separatedSUCCESS/ERROR/TIMEOUT and cold/warm; no operational p95/SLA.
metric_definitions.cost: sum shared-ledger observed calculated cost, conservative reservations retained for unknown usage, include rewrite, retries,smoke,UI; never equate estimated cost with invoice
metric_definitions.human_review: NOT_RUN until explicit human rows are provided and attributed; no paid judge

authorization_requirements: explicit human approval of this run
approved material IDs and source hashes
